blocks.text: ESTATE CLEANOUT FAQ
Estate Cleanout in Woodbridge — Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: How much does an estate cleanout cost in Woodbridge?
a: Estate cleanout pricing is set by truck volume: small cleanouts start at $125, whole estates or business premises scale openly with what their contents fill. The exact figure is written free at the walkthrough — sorting, carrying, hauling and every disposal fee inside — and it’s the invoiced number, kept like a handshake.

items.q: What does an estate cleanout include?
a: A full estate cleanout covers sorting every room, setting aside keepsakes and valuables for the family, donating or recycling what has life left, hauling and responsibly disposing of the rest, and leaving the property broom-swept. Documentation of the donation and disposal split is available for the estate file.

items.q: How do you handle an estate cleanout after a loss?
a: Gently, and at your pace. Keepsakes, photographs, documents and valuables get set aside for the family before and during the clearing — anything meaningful that surfaces comes to you, never a bin by default. Families choose to be present throughout, drop in occasionally, or leave the whole estate cleanout with us.

items.q: My parents are retiring and the business is part of the estate — can you help with that too?
a: Yes, and it’s regular work for us here. Kitchen equipment, fixtures, inventory and decades of paperwork sort with the same respect as the family home, anything meaningful gets set aside before anything moves to disposal or a buyer, and the space hands over swept for whoever’s next.

items.q: We're combining households as part of the estate transition — does that complicate things?
a: Not at all — it’s actually common in Woodbridge. The keep-list comes first, duplicates route donation-first, and the second home clears and finishes sale-ready while the family sorts what’s making the move to the merged household.

items.q: What happens if you find money, jewellery or important documents?
a: They come straight to you or the executor, every time. Estate cleanouts regularly surface cash, jewellery and papers in unexpected places — our crews are trained to slow down exactly there, and the find-and-set-aside habit is non-negotiable.

items.q: Do you work with executors who live out of town or overseas?
a: Regularly. Photographs, written updates and a documented record of anything donated, recycled or set aside let an executor approve every stage of the estate cleanout remotely, without needing to be on site.

items.q: Where do the estate's belongings go?
a: Donation first, always: furniture, housewares and clothing to donation partners, metals, appliances and e-waste to licensed recyclers, landfill strictly last. Documentation of the split is available for the estate’s records.

items.q: Why are your estate cleanout rates 30–50% below the national brands?
a: No franchise royalty inside the quote — we’re local and independent, with our own trucks and crews. The identical estate cleanout, home or business, simply costs less.
